$field_rules: null means 'not obtained'. Never write a guess, and never write 0 to mean none.
price / star_rating / rating_count / availability stay null unless they were read off this listing on retrievedAt — and even then the site's default is to print none of them (Q-13).
observed_* belongs to the observation block of the intent record and is never merged into intent.
commission_category comes from the Associates Commission Income Statement for your locale, not from a blog post about rates.
